issues.title: Shooting at high school in the Philippines leaves 2 students and gunman dead, several injured
issues.title_en: Shooting at high school in the Philippines leaves 2 students and gunman dead, several injured
issues.summary: A shooting at a high school in the southern Philippines has left two 14-year-old students and the teenage gunman dead. Local government and police officials say at least 10 people were wounded. The incident occurred at Banga National High School in South Cotabato. Police have secured the campus and are coordinating with school officials and medical responders. South Cotabato Governor Reynaldo Tamayo says the two students killed were a boy and a girl. Authorities are investigating the gunman’s possible connection to a “true crime community,” as reported by the gunman’s best friend.
